cheap.intent: Status-only recovery, liveness, tiny follow-ups, and very low-risk housekeeping.
cheap.notes: Keep mutation authority narrow. Do not let cheap recovery runs create downstream implementation work.

spark.intent: Small code edits, formatting, simple docs, tiny tests, and quick triage.
spark.notes: Use for bounded, repeatable work. Escalate ambiguity or failed attempts to Terra.

light.intent: Routine coordination, PM/design/doc summaries, basic analysis, and narrow subagent work.
light.notes: Balanced GPT-5.6 lane for routine work; verified against the pinned local Codex CLI.

standard.intent: Normal implementation, debugging, review, verification, and most engineering work.
standard.notes: Default high-quality lane; use this until evidence says a lighter lane is sufficient.

reasoning.intent: Architecture, deployment, security, schema, production, and cross-module decisions.
reasoning.notes: Uses higher reasoning effort; protect this lane from routine paperwork.

strategic.intent: Explicit owner-approved strategic decisions, multi-system design, and high-risk platform direction.
strategic.notes: Highest-quality GPT-5.6 lane for rare, explicit strategic work; Sol passed the live CLI probe on 2026-07-28.
